item.name: Anti-impetum Robe
entries: The fabric pulls gently against sudden motion, as if urging caution.
You have 15 AC against melee attacks. When a melee attack misses you, roll damage for that attack anyway and gain that many Temporary Hit Points.

item.name: Amulet of Cutting Missiles
entries: Mages recognize the Amulet of Cutting Missiles by the faint sparks that dance across its setting.
You can cast {@spell Magic Missile} at its lowest level once per day without expending a spell slot. Each of your Magic Missile darts do +1 additional Force damage.

item.name: Amulet of Rejuvenation
entries: This amulet beats faintly like a second pulse against the chest.
You can cast {@spell Healing Word} at its lowest level once per day without expending a spell slot. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

item.name: Arcane Conduit Staff
entries: Polished and regal, it carries the strange confidence of a ruler who claims kindness and victory alike.

This {@item +1 Quarterstaff} lets you channel magical energies through your allies. Any spell that can be cast from your position can instead be cast from the position of a willing ally or friendly creature within 60 feet of you.

item.name: Argaz's Circus Sash
entries: This brightly colored sash flies impressively behind its wearer's tumbling and springing.

Add your Proficiency Bonus to Acrobatics checks. If you are already proficient in {@skill Acrobatics}, add your Proficiency Bonus a second time. As a Bonus action, you can roll an {@skill Acrobatics} check DC 20 to ignore {@quickref difficult terrain||3} and move along vertical surfaces as if they are horizontal until the end of turn.

item.name: Armor of Many Pelts
entries: Layers of fur whisper of a hundred beasts that once ruled the wild.
This Hide Armor grants +1 to the wearer's Armor Class even while in Wild Shape forms. You also gain +1 to your Spell Save DC and one additional use of Wild Shape per day.

item.name: Barroom Hustler Dart
entries: Light, balanced, and clearly thrown by someone who never planned to lose the wager.

This {@item Dart|PHB} deals {@damage 1d4} Force damage and always hits its target. The {@item Dart|PHB} disappears on impact to reappear in your hand. Attacks with this weapon cannot have their damage increased by any means.

item.name: Blade of the Warden
entries: Its steady edge reflects the calm resolve of one who never abandons their post.
This {@item +1 Longsword} defends its user. As a Reaction, you can parry a melee attack and gain +2 AC against that attack.

item.name: Blinding Buckler
entries: A sudden flash from its mirrored face leaves foes grasping at empty air.
As a Bonus action, you can cast {@spell Color Spray} with a spell save DC of 15 once per day without expending a spell slot.

item.name: Bogle Egg Sac
entries: The lumpy sac pulses faintly, as though the mischief inside is already waiting to escape.

Once per day, as a ritual spell, you can pull one of the slimy eggs from this sac and throw it to the ground. It will immediately hatch into a {@creature bogle|RealmsBeyondTime}, who will follow your spoken commands.

item.name: Boots of the Early Mist
entries: The leather is always cool with dew, as if the dawn itself still walks beside you.
You can cast {@spell Misty Step} once per day without expending a spell slot.

item.name: Bow of Blasting
entries: When its string snaps taut, the air itself seems to flinch.

This {@item +1 Longbow} can fire normal ammunition, but when drawn empty it fires a shimmering arrow that deals {@dice 1d6} plus your Dexterity modifier Force damage. All creatures within 5 feet of the target also take {@damage 1d4} Force damage.

item.name: Corvid Glove
entries: Black leather feathers the wrist, and sometimes the glove seems to move on its own.

You can cast {@spell Mage Hand} once per day. Whenever you cast {@spell Mage Hand}, both the range of Mage Hand and the movement of the hand are increased to 60 feet. You can roll {@skill Sleight of Hand} checks through the hand when you do so through this glove.

item.name: Courier's Cap
entries: Couriers travel without fear of robbery or inspection while wearing this well-worn peaked cap.
Contains an interdimensional space inside large enough for a single Small or Tiny object. Once per day, you can gain +10 feet to your Speed for up to 1 minute.

item.name: Brutal Sapper
entries: The spines of this {@item mace|PHB} are made from a dark, porous metal that seems to resent every blow that doesn't end the fight.
Enemies struck by this {@item Mace|PHB} cannot recover Hit Points until the beginning of your next turn.

item.name: Card Shark's Bracers
entries: The leather is worn smooth by a thousand strikes and just as many losing bets.
Gain Proficiency in Sleight of Hand. Your Dexterity is 14 while you wear these bracers. They have no effect on you if your Dexterity is already 14 or higher without them.

item.name: Chronomancer's Orb
entries: Within the glass, moments swirl like dust caught in slow light.

As a Bonus Action, you can return a target to its position prior to its most recent Move action. If that space is now occupied, the target appears in the nearest unoccupied space. You can use this ability once per day. This item can act as a Spellcasting Focus.

item.name: Eternal Promise Ring
entries: Its unbroken circle glows faintly, remembering a vow that time itself could not erase.
When you heal a creature, that creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your caster level.

item.name: Ember Light Band
entries: Hairline cracks across the Ember Light Band glow faintly like coals when battle begins.
Your weapon attacks also deal{@damage  + 1d4} Fire damage. You can cast the {@spell Light} cantrip at will.

item.name: Draconite Daggers
entries: Made from crystal beaten into a razor's edge, each {@item dagger|PHB} glitters with primeval energies.

This full set of +1 Daggers is sold separately. When you purchase a {@item dagger|PHB}, choose Necrotic, Lightning, Poison, Acid, Fire, or Cold damage. When you attack with this {@item dagger|PHB}, any weapon damage it deals can be replaced with that damage type and you gain Resistance to that damage type until the start of your next turn.

item.name: Curative Periapt
entries: This charm is warm and comforting to the touch to allow its wearer to rest and recover.
Whenever you are healed, you restore the maximum possible number of Hit Points.

item.name: Glaive of the Four Winds
entries: When it moves, the air stirs around the blade as if eager to take part in the battle.
This weapon acts as a {@item +1 Glaive}. Once per day, you can use an action to make an attack against any number of targets within a 10 foot radius of you.

item.name: Gloves of the Late Abbot
entries: The worn leather still carries the calm discipline of hands that once guided both prayer and punishment.
Your Unarmed Strikes do{@damage  + 1d4} Radiant damage. On a hit, recover 2 Hit Points.

item.name: Gorefiend Blade
entries: This jagged-edged weapon remembers every drop of blood it has ever claimed.
This {@item +1 Greatsword} does an additional {@damage 2d6} Slashing damage against targets with full HP. You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the additional damage dealt in this way.

item.name: Glorious Light Shield
entries: Polished to a radiant sheen, it turns every defense into a moment of triumph.
Whenever an opponent makes a ranged or melee attack against you, they take Radiant damage equal to your

item.name: Gloves of the Undercity Brawler
entries: The cracked knuckles of these gloves have settled more arguments than words ever could.

When you make an Unarmed Strike or an attack while in a Wild Shape form, add your Proficiency Bonus to the attack and damage rolls of your first attack each turn. The gloves are considered a Simple Melee weapon with the Finesse and Light properties and deal {@damage 1d6} Bludgeoning damage.

item.name: Grakka's Warbow
entries: Modeled on the mythical bow wielded by the folk hero, Grakka, this massive bow is a sign of strength among nomadic peoples of the plains and steppes.
This {@item +1 Longbow} uses Strength instead of Dexterity for attack and damage rolls. If its user has 15 or more Strength, this bow suffers no penalties at long range.

item.name: Gnomish Grapplewhip
entries: A clever tangle of cord and clockwork that pulls you into the fray.

When this {@item whip|PHB} hits a target, you can attempt to Grapple it. The save DC for the grapple is 8 plus your Dexterity modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus. Inanimate objects automatically fail their saving throw. As long as a target is Grappled this way, you cannot use the Gnomish Grapplewhip for attacks but you can move to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target without consuming an action.

item.name: Gloves of the Twin Flame
entries: When worn together, faint warmth blooms in each palm, like two fires that refuse to burn alone.
Cantrips targeting foes or allies can target an additional creature. The same target cannot be chosen twice. Usable once per Short Rest.

item.name: Grim Breastplate
entries: Embossed with images of death, the dull steel saps your opponents' vitality to make it your own.
This {@item +1 Breastplate} allows you to smite your enemies with fell power. When you successfully hit a target with a melee attack, you can expend a spell slot to deal {@dice 2d4} additional
Necrotic damage. Using a spell slot higher than level 1 deals an additional {@damage 1d4} damage for each additional level.
You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the additional damage dealt in this way.

item.name: Guile Stick
entries: A simple rod that somehow commands respect.

This weapon is treated as a {@item +2 Club} for weapon proficiency and masteries. Wielding this weapon grants +2 to {@skill Intimidation} checks. As a Bonus Action, you can attempt to frighten a creature within 30 feet. Roll an Intimidation check DC 20. If you succeed, that creature is Frightened until your next turn and you cannot use this ability again until after a Long Rest.

item.name: Hammer of Fissures
entries: Each swing promises to remind the earth how easily it can be broken.

This weapon is a {@item +1 Warhammer}. As an action, you can strike the ground at your feet and roll an attack roll against all targets within a 5 foot radius of you in contact with the ground. On a hit, deal {@dice 1d6} plus your Strength modifier Force damage.

item.name: Harbor Guard's Iron
entries: Salt-worn metal carries the steadfast patience of those who watch the tides.
This {@item +1 Half Plate Armor} lets you halt lawbreakers in their tracks. You can use an action to cast the {@spell Web} spell (save DC 13) once per day.

item.name: Hood of Soothing Shadows
entries: The soft darkness beneath its cowl rejuvenates both mind and body.
When you successfully use the {@action Hide} action, you can either restore {@dice 2d8} Hit Points or a level 1 spell slot. You can use this ability once per Short Rest.

item.name: Hushed Magebane
entries: The matte dark wood of this weapon muffles any sound, even when it is loaded and fired.

This {@item +1 Hand Crossbow} can silence its targets. When you hit a target with a bolt from this weapon, you can immediately use a Bonus action to silence the target, preventing the target from casting spells with verbal components until the end of the target's next turn. You can use this ability once per day.

item.name: Infiltrator's Sheath
entries: Made of leather and adorned with a turquoise eye, the edges of this sheath shimmer when seen out of the corner of your eye.

When a one-handed bladed weapon is placed in this sheath, both the sheath and the weapon become {@condition invisible}, as per the spell {@spell Invisibility}. This effect ends once the weapon is drawn. The sheath resizes to the weapon placed in it.

If a creature searching for weapons succeeds at a DC 20 {@skill Perception} or {@skill Investigation} check, they find the {@condition invisible} sheath based on other cues like feeling it or seeing how it affects the wearer's clothing.

item.name: Ironfang
entries: Heavy and unforgiving, it bites through armor, trying to reach that succulent flesh.
This {@item +1 Longsword} can drain the life from your target.

When you successfully hit a target with it, you can use a Bonus action immediately afterward to deal additional Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You gain Hit Points equal to the additional damage dealt this way. Undead and constructs are immune to this effect.

item.name: Occulted Link
entries: Bound by dark magic, this ring turns your veins into a conduit.
Whenever you take damage, you can have your summon, beast companion, or familiar take {@dice 1d8} of that damage instead.

item.name: Motley Coat
entries: A riot of colors and patches hides far more tricks than it reveals.
When an attack roll misses you, deal Psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier to the attacker.

item.name: Necromancer's Rod
entries: The dark wood is warm with the memory of hands that will no longer feel anything but cold.

This weapon acts as a {@item +1 Club}. When you create or take control of undead, that creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your character level. As an action, sacrifice a nearby corpse to give all undead under your control bonuses to attack rolls, damage rolls, and AC equal to your
Proficiency Bonus until the end of your next turn.

item.name: One Stone Bow
entries: This weathered bow remembers the patience of hunters who carried only a single shot worth taking.

When you make a ranged attack with this weapon and hit a target, you can cause the ammunition to ricochet toward a second target within 10 feet of the first. Make a free ranged attack against the second target without expending further ammunition. Each arrow can only ricochet once.

item.name: Oozewarden's Boon
entries: The twisted bogwood is slick with unwholesome moisture, but your grip is adhered to its surface.

This {@item +1 Quarterstaff} makes your acid attacks viscous and sticky. Whenever a target fails a saving throw against a spell dealing Acid damage, the target also suffers -10 Speed until the end of its next turn and takes an additional {@damage 1d4} Acid damage at the start of each of its turns until it leaves its spot.

item.name: Pouch of Smoke Bombs
entries: The faint smell of acrid powder promises a swift and dramatic exit.

This belt pouch contains two smoke bombs. As an action, retrieve a smoke bomb and throw it anywhere you can see within 60 feet. Anything within a 10-foot radius of impact is {@quickref Vision and Light||2||Heavily Obscured} for 1 round and {@quickref Vision and Light||2||Lightly Obscured} for the following round. All creatures caught in the radius must re-roll their Initiative. The pouch replenishes the smoke bombs at dawn.

item.name: Prehensile Whip
entries: Never quite still, the lash coils and twists as it waits for something to occupy it.
This {@item +1 Whip} can be used to perform {@skill Sleight of Hand} checks from 10 feet away. You also gain +2 to Climb checks.

item.name: Primordial Savant Staff
entries: The ancient wood thrums with knowledge older than any spellbook.

This {@item +1 Quarterstaff} grants you the power of elemental forces. Any level 1 or higher spell you cast that does Fire, Poison, Cold, Lightning, or Acid damage can be changed to any of the other three damage types. As long as the last spell damage the target took was of a different type from the type you just chose, roll an additional damage die for your spell.

item.name: Quicksilver Lance
entries: Its shining shaft seems to shift like liquid metal just before the strike.

This weapon acts as a {@item +1 Lance}. If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a free melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

item.name: Reflex Shield
entries: The moment danger strikes, this shield moves faster than thought, interposing itself with uncanny precision.
This Shield grants you a +2 bonus to your AC. You can also cast {@spell Shield} as a Reaction without expending a spell slot once per day.

item.name: Resonant Maul
entries: Each strike hums through stone and bone alike, echoing long after the blow has fallen.

On a hit, this {@item +1 Maul} imposes Disadvantage on the target's checks to maintain {@status Concentration}. Once per day, it can cast {@spell Silence} at its lowest level without expending a spell slot centered on itself.

item.name: Ring of the Deep Shadows
entries: The metal drinks the light around it, as though it remembers darker places than this.
The wearer's weapons and Unarmed Strikes deal an additional {@damage 1d4} damage against targets when attacking from stealth. Gain +2 to {@skill Stealth}.

item.name: Ring of the Shifter
entries: Slender and unassuming, Ring of the Shifter carries magic that reveals itself only when truly needed.
Whenever you are in a form that consumed a Wild Shape charge, gain +2 to AC and +2 to attacks until the form ends.

item.name: Spellweaver's Signet
entries: The ring glows faintly when magic gathers, eager to join the pattern.

This ring allows the wearer to redirect magical energies. When an opponent casts a spell, as a Reaction you can expend a spell slot of the same level to gain Advantage on saving throws to that spell. This item can act as a Spellcasting Focus.

item.name: Smuggler's Duster
entries: Its many hidden seams whisper of secrets that passed quietly through guarded doors.

On command, an interdimensional pocket appears in the lining of this coat that can contain up to 15 lbs of inanimate matter. There is no air inside, so any living being placed inside will die of suffocation if left inside for too long. You can retrieve an item by thinking about which object you want to retrieve. Another command seals the pocket. This item does not appear magical under {@spell Detect Magic}.

item.name: Stormkin Axe
entries: Static prickles along its haft, eager for the swing that will set it loose upon your enemies.

This {@item +1 Battleaxe} also has the {@itemProperty T||Thrown} property (Range 20/60). When thrown, it deals {@dice 1d4} additional Lightning damage to its target and any creature within 5 feet of the thrown axe's direct path. You can command the axe to return to you as a Bonus Action, dealing {@damage 1d4} Lightning damage to any creature within 5 feet of its direct return path to you.

item.name: Suction Pouch
entries: Once something drops inside, the pouch clings to it with a stubbornness bordering on spite.

As an action, you can pick up all Tiny or smaller inanimate objects (coins, ammunition, caltrops, etc.) within 5 feet of you if the Suction Pouch is empty. When used as part of a {@skill Sleight of Hand} check to steal or hide such objects, gain Advantage on that check. You can retrieve one or more items from the Suction Pouch as an action.

item.name: Summoner's Cane
entries: The polished tip taps impatiently, waiting for something from elsewhere to answer.

This weapon acts as a {@item +1 Quarterstaff}. When you are {@status concentration||Concentrating} on a spell, all your summoned creatures gain{@dice  + 1d4} to attack rolls and saving throws as long as you maintain {@status Concentration}.

item.name: Switch Knuckles
entries: A flick of the wrist sends hidden steel snapping into place with a sound that ends conversations.

Gain +1 to attack and damage on your Unarmed Strikes. Your Unarmed Strikes now do your choice of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage and count as magical for the purposes of overcoming resistance and immunity.

item.name: Sword of Spectacle
entries: Every thrust and riposte demands an audience, and the blade never disappoints.

This {@item +1 Rapier} allows you to roll a {@skill Performance} check when you are hit by an attack. Until the end of your next turn, your AC is equal to the result of that check. You can use this once per day for free or expend a use of Bardic Inspiration to use it an additional time.

item.name: The Rewoven Loop
entries: This endless ring bears the careful stitches of something once broken and mended.

After you have moved on your turn, you can activate the ring as a Bonus Action to teleport back to the location where you started your turn. Your next {@skill Stealth} or {@skill Athletics} check is made with Advantage. Use once per Short Rest.

item.name: The Hidden Hermit's Pocket Closet
entries: A humble ring with a pocket that unfolds into a space far larger than any hermit should reasonably need.

Your Speed increases by 10 feet while Invisible, transformed, or Wild Shaped. Whenever you cast a Transmutation or Illusion spell on yourself, and whenever you Wild Shape into a different form, you can change your items, weapons, and outfit as a free action.

item.name: Z'lethan Guardian Spear
entries: Its bone point has stood vigilant longer than the Z'lethan kingdoms who made it.
This {@item +1 Spear} makes its wielder Immune to the Poisoned condition and Resistant to Poison damage. Once per day, if you fail a saving throw you can retry it once.

trait.name: Slippery Little Thing
entries: The bogle can move through or occupy the space of any creature that is Medium or larger.

trait.name: Escape Artist
entries: When making a Strength check for an action to break itself (or another creature) free from being {@condition restrained}, it always succeeds.

action.name: Slippery Slap
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) Bludgeoning damage. If the bogle hits a creature with this attack, it becomes slick with grime until the start of the bogle's next turn. During that time, the bogle gains a +2 bonus to AC and saving throws from that creature.

action.name: Hop
entries: The bogle jumps up to 5 feet. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. The hop can be used as part of its action.
